youtube.baslik: For someone with one implant, does the talker's side matter? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: For a person with an implant in one ear, if speech comes from the side without the implant, the head shadows it and it reaches the implanted ear weakened; if speech comes from the implanted side and noise from the other side, things are much better. So the success of someone with a single implant depends strongly on which side the talker is sitting on; adding a device or implant to the second ear gives an ear in a good position at all times.

Picture a person with an implant in only one ear.
